notes.title: We’re sorry, but the release of our game has been delayed due to Steam's review
notes.notes: We worked until the 27th to enrich the content of the game, which resulted in submitting it for review later than planned. Steam's review process usually takes 3–5 days, and we deeply regret that this caused another delay in releasing the game. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Game Release Delayed to Dec 31 Due to Optimization
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45176897/7ae8e05a7611a9197e44e43e854b869f14cc4495.png
我们意外的发现游戏实机出现了翻页时内存占用激增的问题，我们在努力的试图优化这个问题，同时继续打磨游戏的实机画面。但是请放心，游戏的所有剧情和文本逻辑以及插图已经在inky中完全制作完毕！感谢大家的理解
We've unexpectedly discovered an issue where memory usage spikes during page turns in the game's live environment. We're working hard to optimize this while continuing to polish the in-game visuals. Rest assured, all storylines, text logic, and illustrations have been fully completed in Inky! Thank you all for your understanding.
